desc: Derive the exact O(N²) interval DP recurrence (e.g., dp[l][r] = max(dp[l+1][r-1] + |A[l]-A[r]|, max over splits dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r])) and prove it handles the non-crossing matching constraint correctly
Implement the O(N²) DP in Python and verify it produces the correct outputs for all sample inputs (5, 14, 0)
Verify the greedy approach against additional test cases, especially edge cases with equal elements or monotonic sequences.
Prove the correctness of the greedy approach using the Monge property or exchange argument, or find a counterexample that invalidates it.
If a counterexample is found, implement the O(N log N) interval DP with segment tree optimization for the two cases of |a-b|.
Write the final optimized Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer) and ensure it passes within time/memory limits for the maximum constraints
